name: Netcall AI Widget
description: Add the Netcall AI widget to your website.
project_description:
Back to top 

 INTRODUCTION 
 The Netcall AI Widget module allows sites to embed the Netcall AI widget on their website.

 You can enable it sitewide so it appears on all pages. Once that is done, you can override it on a page-by-page basis or site-section basis to show other versions of the widget in other places.

 Back to top 

 REQUIREMENTS 
 This module has no other requirements.

 Back to top 

 INSTALLATION 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module.

See: https://www.drupal.org/node/895232 for further information.

 Back to top 

 CONFIGURATION 
 - Configuration settings page: /admin/config/services/netcall/ai-widget

- Permissions page: /admin/people/permissions/module/netcall_ai_widget

 Back to top
